blocks.t: **Objetivo de comunicação (C1):** eu consigo integrar leitura, escuta, fala e escrita sobre negociações e usar o phrasal verb step down.

body: Esta aula treina **ler textos curtos e achar informação (IELTS Reading, TOEFL Reading)**.

blocks.t: Toque em 🔊, ouça e repita cada palavra. Depois tente adivinhar o sentido.

blocks.title: Review: “The Art of Giving Ground”
paras: This book argues that the best negotiators know when to **give ground**. **Much as** many managers prefer to win, the author shows that mutual gain beats victory. **Strange as it may seem**, the chapter on knowing when to **step down** is the strongest: leaders who refuse to resign after a failed deal **undermine** their teams.

**Given that** the book is short, its coverage is impressive. **Try as it might**, however, it fails to **account for** cultural differences in bargaining. Verdict: **a fundamental shift** in how we think about winning, **though** not without gaps.

items.q: The author believes winning is always the best outcome.
The chapter on stepping down is the strongest.
The reviewer finds the book very long.

blocks.body: **step down** é **inseparável** e intransitivo: *The CEO stepped down.* (✗ *stepped the CEO down*). Use *step down from the post* ou *step down as*.

items.s: The CEO ___ down after the failed deal. (step, past)
Much ___ many prefer to win, mutual gain is better. (as)
The book fails to account ___ cultural differences. (for)

blocks.title: Match the word to its meaning

items.ans: Much as it hurts sometimes yes
items.pt: Por mais que doa, às vezes sim.

body: **Give ground** — Ceder terreno
**Hold one’s ground** — Manter-se firme
**Win-win** — Ganha-ganha
**Throw in the towel** — Jogar a toalha
**Fall on one’s sword** — Assumir a culpa e sair
**Pass the baton** — Passar o bastão
**Bow out gracefully** — Sair de cena com elegância
**Live to fight another day** — Sobreviver para lutar outro dia
**Much as it hurts, sometimes yes.** — Por mais que doa, às vezes sim.
**Should a leader step down after a failure?** — Um líder deve renunciar após um fracasso?
**Refusing to step down can undermine the team.** — Recusar-se a renunciar pode minar a equipe.

blocks.task: Write a 7-sentence review of a book, article or film about leadership, using step down and two concessive structures.
blocks.model: The film is a portrait of a manager who steps down after a mistake. Much as I admire his honesty, I wish it had been less sentimental. Strange as it may seem, the best scenes are silent. It accounts for the company’s decline in a convincing way. Though short, it feels complete. A fundamental shift in how we see failure, it is worth watching. Verdict: thoughtful and humane.
